name: party-in-pink-monorepo
description: Party In Pink 5.0 Event Platform Monorepo

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --project demo-pip5 --only firestore,storage "vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/firebase-rules.spec.ts tests/workflow-emulator.spec.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:local: npm run build --workspace=@pip/functions && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --project demo-pip5 --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "tsx tests/e2e-local-workflow.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:buyer: npm run build --workspace=@pip/functions && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --project demo-pip5 --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "tsx tests/e2e-samarth-buyer.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:slack: npm run build --workspace=@pip/functions && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --project demo-pip5 --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "tsx tests/e2e-slack-ticketing.ts"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@pip/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pip/functions && npm run typecheck --workspace=@pip/web
